explanation: Floor division omits the final partial page (for example, 11 items at size 10 reports 1 page). Return a ceiling division for positive totals while preserving zero total as zero.

page_items accepts page values below 1; page 0 or negative values produce negative slice offsets and can return unrelated tail data instead of enforcing one-based pagination. Reject page < 1 before calculating the offset.
page_items does not enforce a positive size, so zero silently returns an empty page and negative sizes use Python's reverse-bound slicing semantics. Reject size <= 0 consistently with page_count.
